PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY.INTRO_BODY_1: This Privacy Policy describes how PilateSafe handles data for apps distributed via the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
PRIVACY.INTRO_BODY_2: PilateSafe is developed by PilateSafe. For support or privacy inquiries, email Stu.Schwartz@gmail.com or use the support channels listed in the app store listing.
PRIVACY.DATA_BODY_1: PilateSafe does not collect personal information from users during normal app operation.
PRIVACY.DATA_BODY_2: The app stores only local device data related to the user experience, including selected theme preferences and a local daily AI usage counter.
PRIVACY.DATA_BODY_3: The app does not collect or transmit health data, contact data, location data, camera or microphone input, or device identifiers for analytics.
PRIVACY.STORAGE_BODY_1: PilateSafe is built for offline-first operation. Exercise guidance, contraindication information, and program content are bundled locally in the app.
PRIVACY.STORAGE_BODY_2: If on-device AI is enabled, the model assets are also loaded from local app files and are not requested from a remote service.
PRIVACY.NETWORK_BODY_1: The app does not transmit your selected conditions, entered text, or personal health information to external servers during normal use.
PRIVACY.NETWORK_BODY_2: Network calls are limited to loading bundled assets from the app package and any future updates the app may request through standard update channels.
PRIVACY.THIRDPARTY_BODY_1: PilateSafe does not share user data with third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking services.
PRIVACY.THIRDPARTY_BODY_2: No third-party SDKs are used for data collection by default. The app does not sell personal or sensitive user data.
PRIVACY.CHILDREN_BODY: The app is not directed to children under the age of 13 and does not knowingly collect personal information from children.
PRIVACY.RETENTION_BODY_1: Local settings and counters are retained on the device until the app is uninstalled or cleared by the user.
PRIVACY.RETENTION_BODY_2: To delete all locally stored data, uninstall the app or clear the app storage in your device settings.
PRIVACY.SECURITY_BODY: The app uses standard Ionic/Capacitor WebView storage mechanisms and local browser storage. It does not use device sensors, contacts, location, camera, microphone, or other sensitive permissions as part of its core functionality.
PRIVACY.UPDATES_BODY: This policy may be updated to reflect new legal requirements or app features. The effective date above will be revised when changes are made.
PRIVACY.CONTACT_BODY: If you have questions about this policy, email
